chapters.title: Experiment A
content: Shun Uruma is a kind-hearted elementary school student who is tortured by five of his classmates [citation:1][citation:5].
They label him 'Experiment A' and subject him to horrific bullying [citation:5].
The abuse leaves Shun physically and mentally scarred [citation:1].
His bullies are led by a sadistic boy named Kyou Shigoku [citation:2].
The bullying does not stop at school; the bullies target Shun's family [citation:1][citation:5].
Shun's parents are killed in a traffic accident orchestrated by Kyou [citation:1][citation:2].
His younger brother, Kakeru, is left in a coma from the same incident [citation:1][citation:2].
Shun is left with nobody but his grandfather, Noboru [citation:1][citation:5].
Noboru was a member of a secret assassination unit during the Pacific War [citation:1][citation:2].
Seeing Shun's desire for revenge, Noboru begins training him in the art of killing [citation:1].
The training includes murder techniques, torture methods, and body disposal [citation:1][citation:2].
Shun vows to avenge his family by killing the five bullies who destroyed his life [citation:1].
His journey of revenge has begun.
The stage is set for a bloody confrontation.

chapters.title: The First Target
content: Years pass, and Shun Uruma, now in high school, begins his hunt [citation:1].
He seeks out the first of his five tormentors: Katsumi Senkouji.
Katsumi is the first bully to fall, marking the start of Shun's campaign [citation:1][citation:8].
Shun's actions draw the attention of the authorities.
The police, led by Inspector Mizuki Anzai, begin investigating the mysterious deaths [citation:2].
Shun's life becomes a dangerous game of cat and mouse.
He must evade the police while continuing his mission.
Chizuru Azuma, a normal high schooler, gets involved in Shun's life after he saves her from an attacker [citation:1].
Azuma develops feelings for Shun and becomes a key figure in his life [citation:1].
She learns about his dark past but chooses to support him [citation:1].
Shun tries to keep Azuma at arm's length to protect her from his dangerous world [citation:1].
The hunt for the five bullies continues.
Each target represents a different type of evil.
Shun's path becomes increasingly bloody.

chapters.title: The Priest
content: Shun sets his sights on his next target, Yuuga Ushiro [citation:8].
In the present, Yuuga is the head of a criminal prostitution ring [citation:2][citation:8].
He is a manipulator who uses sexual exploitation to control others [citation:2].
Shun investigates Teisei Academy, the school where Ushiro operates [citation:9].
He learns about Ushiro's high school girlfriend, Karen Sakuraba [citation:8].
Karen has been missing for a long time [citation:8].
Shun discovers that Ushiro has been keeping Karen captive.
Ushiro's brutality is horrifying.
Shun decides to make Ushiro pay for his crimes [citation:2].
He uses the skills his grandfather taught him to break Ushiro.
Ushiro's empire of exploitation comes crumbling down [citation:8].
However, Ushiro survives Shun's initial attack.
Shun must finish what he started.
The game of cat and mouse continues.

chapters.title: The Ring's End
content: Shun closes in on Yuuga Ushiro [citation:2].
Karen Sakuraba, Ushiro's victim, decides to take her own revenge [citation:2].
She has been tortured and broken for years.
Shun confronts Ushiro and tortures him using a device called a 'pear of anguish' [citation:2].
The pain is immense and humiliating for Ushiro.
Before Shun can finish the job, Karen intervenes [citation:2].
She kills Ushiro herself, taking the final step in her liberation [citation:2].
Shun's second target is dead.
The police investigation intensifies, and Shun is a prime suspect [citation:1][citation:2].
His activities are becoming harder to hide.
Chizuru Azuma is drawn deeper into his world.
Shun knows that time is running out.
He must complete his mission before he is caught.
The next target is already in his sights.

chapters.title: The Man's Mission
content: Shun's grandfather, Noboru, is a guiding force in his life [citation:2].
He is the one who trained Shun to become a killer [citation:1].
Noboru's past is tied to the Kure Naval District 100th Special Land Squadron [citation:1][citation:2].
His specialized knowledge makes him a formidable figure.
Noboru uses his expertise to help Shun with his operations, such as eliminating evidence [citation:2].
His primary goal is to protect Shun and his brother [citation:1].
Noboru's methods are brutal but effective.
He wants Shun to survive his war of revenge.
However, Noboru is targeted by one of Kyou's henchmen.
Andou Midori attacks the Uruma household to save Kyou [citation:1].
The confrontation puts everyone at risk.
Shun's family is in danger once again.
The war with Kyou is far from over.
The stakes continue to rise.

chapters.title: The Cop's Hunt
content: The Metropolitan Police Department is closing in on Shun [citation:2].
Inspector Mizuki Anzai is leading the investigation [citation:2].
Her husband, Zenichi Anzai, is a murder victim, giving her a personal stake [citation:1][citation:2].
She is determined to uncover the truth behind Shun's revenge [citation:2].
Detective Asako Oota is also working on the case [citation:2].
They begin probing the edges of the Revolution Club, Kyou's cult [citation:2].
The police are starting to connect Shun to the deaths.
Their scrutiny complicates Shun's plans.
He must be more careful than ever.
The pressure from the police is intense.
Mizuki and Asako are relentless in their pursuit.
Shun is trapped between his enemies and the law.
He cannot afford any mistakes.
The hunt is becoming a desperate race.

chapters.title: The Revolution
content: Shun finally confronts the mastermind behind his suffering: Kyou Shigoku [citation:1].
Kyou is the leader of a powerful cult called the Revolution Club [citation:1][citation:2].
He has formed new allies, making him more dangerous than ever.
The confrontation is brutal and personal.
Shun is determined to make Kyou suffer as he has suffered.
The battle is a clash of two monsters.
Shun and Kyou are seemingly killed in the final confrontation [citation:1].
Kyou escapes the gym with his followers [citation:1].
The police arrest Shun for the murder of Zenichi Anzai [citation:1].
He is imprisoned for five years.
Shun has failed to kill Kyou.
The mastermind is still out there.
His revenge is incomplete.
The nightmare continues.

chapters.title: The Facility
content: During Shun's imprisonment, Kyou's followers, led by Momoki, attempt to kill him.
An assassination attempt results in Shun losing his memories [citation:1].
A member of the 'Juujika-san' organization, Kitami, recruits him [citation:1].
Juujika-san is a covert vigilante network [citation:1][citation:2].
They operate on a philosophy of 'heroic intervention' for a fee [citation:2].
They eliminate threats to society that the law cannot touch.
The organization provides resources for high-risk operations.
The town doctor manages client intake and administrative duties [citation:2].
A nurse facilitates on-site care and body processing [citation:2].
The organization exists in the shadows.
Their goals align with Shun's new path.
Shun, now 21, works under Kitami [citation:1].
He is broken and confused.
The path to vengeance begins again.

chapters.title: The Reunion
content: Shun Uruma, now working for the 'Juujika-san' organization, reunites with Chizuru Azuma [citation:1].
She has a new job and longer hair [citation:1].
She is determined to help Shun despite his memory loss [citation:1].
Shun largely avoids her feelings, wanting to protect her [citation:1].
After the timeskip, he finally seems to reciprocate her feelings [citation:1].
Their relationship is a small light in the darkness.
However, the world is still a dangerous place.
Kyou is still out there, more powerful than ever.
The Revolution Club is continuing its operations [citation:1].
Momoki, Kyou's lover, is a major threat [citation:1].
Shun's past is coming back to haunt him.
He must prepare for the final confrontation.
Azuma is his only anchor to his former self.
The endgame is approaching.

chapters.title: The Cruel Game
content: Kyou, Shun's archenemy, forces a cruel game to continue [citation:1].
A computer-generated arrow chooses targets among Shun's allies [citation:1].
Hanaoka is killed first [citation:1].
The arrow then chooses Chizuru Azuma [citation:1].
Azuma is injected with a poison made by Momoki [citation:1].
The poison makes her lose all of her senses before she dies [citation:1].
Azuma dies a horrific death [citation:1].
Kyou's game is a masterpiece of psychological torture.
Shun is forced to watch as his loved ones are taken from him.
The cruelty is beyond imagining.
Shun's will is tested to its breaking point.
He loses the woman he loved.
The weight of loss and anger is crushing.
Shun's final battle is coming.

chapters.title: The Final Confrontation
content: Shun and Kyou finally face off in a final showdown [citation:1].
The battle is for everything.
The outcome of their conflict is the end of a long, bloody journey.
Shun has been poisoned by Momoki [citation:1].
He is slowly losing his senses.
He must kill Kyou before the poison kills him [citation:11].
The battle is a brutal and desperate struggle.
Shun fights with everything he has left.
He finally succeeds in killing Kyou [citation:1].
However, Shun dies from the poison Momoki injected him [citation:1].
His revenge is complete, but it has cost him everything.
Azuma's death and his own death finalize his story.
The cycle of revenge has reached its bloody end.
The story concludes with Shun's death.
